meta.title: Studio
meta.description: Tune who the assistant is talking to, how it behaves, and which models run it.

live_answers.name: Live answers
live_answers.help: Live replies: the overlay, the chat and answers during a meeting. The prompt sets the tone, length and format of what the assistant says.

screenshots.name: Screenshots
screenshots.help: Screenshot analysis: the “Screenshot” button in the overlay and screen sharing in a meeting. The prompt tells the model how to read the image and what to answer.

code.name: Code
code.help: Questions about code and algorithms. The prompt sets the programming language, how much to explain, and whether to show complexity and tests.

system_design.name: System Design
system_design.help: Architecture questions in interviews. The prompt sets the structure of the walkthrough: requirements, estimates, design and trade-offs.

notes.name: Notes & maps
notes.description: AI version of meeting notes and the mind map
notes.help: The AI version of meeting notes and the mind map. The prompt decides what to keep: decisions, action items, open questions.

context.intro: A short text about you. Every answer to you takes it into account — Leo’s and each role’s. Meeting notes, which colleagues read, don’t use it. The more precise it is, the fewer follow-up questions.
context.title: About you
context.description: Who you are, what you work on and how you like answers. Facts beat adjectives.
context.example:
Role: Senior backend engineer, 6 years, fintech.
Stack: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes.
Now: preparing for system design interviews at product companies.
Answers: concise, with trade-offs; code in Python unless I say otherwise.
Avoid: generic advice, long introductions.
context.count: {count, number} / {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} · ~{tokens, plural, one {# token} other {# tokens}}

preview.title: What the model receives
preview.description: Your context goes into every answer to you, after Shosai’s instructions and before the role’s prompt.
preview.question: Your question
preview.questionHint: What you ask Leo or a role

models.defaultHint: Shosai picks the model for this role
models.unavailable: The chosen model is no longer available to you, so the default answers.
